items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: I know him good. He used to be a musician.

ctx.x: What did John Pendleton play? John Pendleton? John Pendleton used to play.

What did John Pendleton used to play? John Pendleton used to play. I'm getting it true. I forgot what instrument he used to play, John Pendleton. I know him good. He used to be a musician. But what instrument he used to play? I don't know. You know the way he got that.
